create_renderer_vispy: create a RendererVispy instance with specified width, height, mode, and shading for 3D rendering
add_object_to_renderer: add a 3D object model from a PLY file to the renderer with optional surface color
render_object_rgb_depth: render an object at a given pose returning RGB and/or depth images via render_object
remove_object_from_renderer: remove a previously added object model and its GPU buffers from the renderer
calc_calib_proj_matrix: convert a Hartley-Zisserman camera intrinsic matrix to an OpenGL projection matrix
